description:
Our team is growing, and we're looking for an experienced Development BI & ETL Analyst with a passion for data, reporting, and ETL processes. If you enjoy turning data into actionable insights, we'd love to hear from you.


Project Description:

  • Ensures the implementation of a part or modules from projects or applications defined in specifications.
  • Participates in the analysis of defining the requirements and the realization of the software development for the internal applications with a focus on the tools Power BI and Talend.


RESPONSIBILITIES

New features:

  • Feasibility study and estimate the workload required to achieve the development & unit tests.
  • Assist the business analysts with the elaboration of functional specification.
  • Validate the detailed functional specifications with BA and QA.
  • Produce the detailed technical specifications.
  • Perform the development and unit & integration tests and ensure compliance with the technical specifications.
  • Perform automated code reviews regularly to anticipate and avoid potential new vulnerabilities and bugs
  • Ensure deliveries to other teams (Homologation & subsidiaries worldwide)
  • Anticipate alerts to the project manager if there is a potential risk such as a delay in delivery.
  • Fix potential bugs during the acceptance phase.
  • Code/set-up and document what is produced.
  • Update the Architecture Document and the Security Folder with each evolution.
  • Comply with the standards and procedures (architecture, security, quality, documentation).
  • Appropriating the operating rules of the development environment.
  • You challenge the status quo, follow innovative standards and technology trends in order to provide the best possible solution to our colleagues and customer .
  • Maintenance (bug fixing & support requests).
  • Provide IT support to subsidiaries after deliveries in UAT & PROD.
  • Contribute to support requests and fix anomalies raised by subsidiaries.
  • Conduct technical meetings with the technical teams of the subsidiaries.
  • Maintain the versioning of the applications.
  • Coordinate with IT team to maintain the work environments (development & integration & homologation).
  • Take charge of the relationship with the various contacts external to the service (Infrastructure, Architects, Security) and ensure end-to-end initiation and follow-up of requests with these teams.
  • Provide internal support to BA & QA on work environments.


Profile

  • Experience in similar positions of minimum 2 years;
  • Very good knowledge of reporting program PowerBI;
  • Knowledge of SQL and writing SQL queries in one or many SQL Databases;
  • Experience working with tools for creating ETLs: Example Talend;
  • Proven experience with Java programming language;
  • RPA knowledge (UiPath) is a plus;
  • Experience in insurance / banking / financial services is considered a plus;
  • Experience working with CRM configuration;
  • Understanding of the client/server and n-tier architectures;
  • Foreign languages – English – good skills level (spoken and written).
